dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, light-toned rings with thin, high-contrast perimeters against a dark grey base. Prominent closed O-shaped rings are clustered in the central and posterior dorsal regions, showing a sharp gradient transition from light perimeter to darker interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity blobs; however, discrete, low-intensity irregular patches are interspersed between light-toned rings, particularly concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A cluster of four prominent macro-annuli in the mid-body forms a skewed rectangular polygon. An additional triangle is formed by the centroids of three distinct rings located towards the posterior dorsal curve.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct brownish-rust colored oxidation or staining is visible on the posterior-most lateral surface, contrasting with the primarily grey and white tonal palette of the rest of the body.
